Summary: Payment shall be made within 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement.
Quote: Payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.4;
Notes: Page 76 mentions a partial release of 90% within 10 days of the engineer's recommendation, but the final due period for payment of the statement is 30 days. Interest on delayed payment is specified as Bank Rate plus 3% under Clause 17.7.2.

Summary: 6% of each payment for Works is deducted as retention money, subject to a maximum of 5% of the Contract Price.
Quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
Notes: Clause mentions the per-bill deduction is 6%, but the total retention money is capped at 5% of the Contract Price.

Summary: 10% of the Contract Price as an advance payment for mobilisation and equipment.
Quote: The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to 10% (ten per cent)7 of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition of equipment. The Advance Payment shall carry simple interest at the rate of 8% (eight per cent) per annum and shall be made in two equal instalments.
Notes: Carries simple interest at 8% per annum, paid in two equal instalments. Recoverable through proportionate deductions in Interim Payment Certificates. Page 160 (Schedule-F Annex-III form of guarantee) refers to the advance as interest-free and in three instalments, presenting a conflict with the main body clause.

Summary: 0.05% of the contract price per day of delay for failing to meet milestones or completion date.
Quote: it shall pay Damages to the Authority in a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five per cent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule - I and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Works are completed
Notes: Damages are payable after a 30-day grace period from the date set forth in Schedule-I. Refundable without interest if works are completed within time extension.

Quote: The following percentages shall govern the price adjustment of the Contract Price:
Notes: Specific component percentages are detailed in a matrix for different work types (Road Works, Bridges, etc.).

Summary: 5% of the Contract Price provided as an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee.
Quote: The Contractor shall, for the performance of its obligations hereunder, provide to the Authority, within 15 (fifteen) days of the date of this Agreement, an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee, for an amount equal to 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price, from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-F (the “Performance Security”).
Notes: Must be from a Bank; valid until 60 days of the expiry of the Defects Liability Period.
